source.name: Stade Brestois 29: Football à la Pointe
source.quote: 1 000€ seront versés au titre d'un investissement sponsoring et assureront la visibilité du Football à la Pointe, s'affichant symboliquement sur la manche du maillot de l'équipe professionnelle tout au long de la saison.
source.note: The club page says the mark sits "sur la manche" (sleeve); the club's 2026/27 launch photos and shop packshot show the "LE FOOTBALL À LA POINTE" mark as a patch at the hem of the shirt, so it is filed as patch.

source.note: Kit maker: the launch article describes the shirt as the adidas "Tiro26 competition" model.

summary: adidas home shirt (Tiro26 competition): Quéguiner Matériaux centre front, Guyot Environnement, Sill and Oceania Hotels on the chest, Le Rond Central on the sleeve, the Le Football à la Pointe patch at the hem, Oriance and J.Bervas Automobiles on the back, from the club's launch and shop photos. Sponsor list not confirmed complete: no cited source shows the 2026/27 match shorts (earlier data listed E.Leclerc and Groupe SOFT there, without a source).
